newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian forint ends firmer against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian forint ends firmer against the dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint, boosted by the mark's strength against the dollar, closed up against the U.S. currency, dealers said on Tuesday.
"Before the (Hungarian) market closed, the dollar began to go down against the mark," Europai Kereskedelmi Bank's Peter Piros said.
The forint finished at 151.39/41, compared with its opening 151.80 and 151.59/64 at the end of the morning session.
The forint ended close to the National Bank of Hungary's resistance level (bid), after moving in a 40 filler range below the NBH bid in the morning.
The forint floats within the NBH's 4.5 percent intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the Ecu.
The dollar took advantage of the U.S. missile attack on Iraq in futures on the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE), which only trade in the morning.
Dollar futures firmed on the BCE, the mark and the Ecu mainly eased.
